name: 77382 · The Woodlands, TX
findings: ZIP 77382 (The Woodlands) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77382 (The Woodlands) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
